facts.title: Spaghetti Squash "Pizza" Bowls
ingredients: 2 medium-to-large spaghetti squash (about 5.5 pounds total), or 3 small
4 teaspoons + 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, divided
4 medium cloves garlic, pressed or minced
⅔ cup (2 ounces) grated Parmesan cheese
8 ounces (2 cups) grated part-skim mozzarella cheese
Pinch of red pepper flakes, optional
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
